name: Indiginus The Ukulele
help: Indiginus. In Kontakt: SOLO mode (CC102 Solo); DISABLE CHORDS KEY SW on (default); Exp CC11 amount up (the default looks low); velocity grid Low = Mutes, High = off; Master Key = the song's key. Articulation keys are momentary (confirmed by the D0 test, 2026-10-07): the driver holds a key for the ornamented note only. Narrow "range" to the keys Kontakt colours as playable. Slots mode only: CHORDS mode and chord keyswitches enabled. Chord quality keys (C5-F7) not mapped yet - confirm Major/Minor/7th keys in Kontakt and fill variationKeys (chordKeys major/minor/seventh). Our voicings assume Hi-G (reentrant) tuning.
